messages:
alex: Heads-up — we've got a small spike in console query tail latency related to tenant-slicing queries. Not an incident but visible in last 6 hours. Wondering whether we want to accelerate the 'slice debt' plan from the RFC follow-up.

maria-plat: saw the same.  p99 went from ~420ms -> ~620ms on dashboard-heavy tenants. Looks correlated with large multi-tenant joins + RBAC filter expansion.

jordan-sre: last deploy touched the authz pushdown change, but I don't think it's the root. Telemetry shows increased rows scanned per request for a subset of dashboards.

lia-product: user reports started around when a couple of large customers enabled granular perms. Could be mesh of authz + tiling.

alex: agreed — probable interplay: authz filters trickle into query planner and disable some pre-tiling pruning. Two options: (A) fast mitigation = add a short-circuit that applies tenant-level deny masks earlier, or (B) longer-term = rework tenant-slice vectorization to keep authz as first-class predicate.

maria-plat: quick short-circuit seems low-risk. We can implement as a pre-filter in the console query gateway to reduce rows hitting the engine. Pros: immediate SLO win. Cons: duplicate logic (DRY violation) and risk of divergence from main authz rules.

jordan-sre: agree. Also consider rate-based throttling for dashboards that escalate rows scanned. We have telemetry to identify offenders and throttle to protect the tail.

lia-product: users will hate throttles — prefer transparent mitigation with clear rollout notes. If we throttle, let's be conservative and use canary first.

alex: proposal: do both. 1) Ship pre-filter short-circuit behind a feature flag + canary on small percentage of traffic. 2) Add a protection rule in the gateway to cap worst-case row scans per tenant per minute (soft throttle + alert). 3) Parallel RFC follow-up to redesign slice vectorization to keep authz predicates at index level.

maria-plat: estimated effort: short-circuit gateway change ~1-2 days + tests. Throttle rule + telemetry alerting ~1 day. Slice vectorization RFC follow-up larger — probably 2 sprint plan with a prototype.

jordan-sre: can implement gateway change today, will open a PR. I can also add a k8s feature-flag rollout and a small canary.

dev-bot: Deploy bot: rolled up canary flag for gateway feature "authz_prefilter" to 5% for alex-canary at 2024-08-22T14:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria-plat: after canary looks stable, we should run a synthetic workload hitting a known bad dashboard to validate p99 improvement. Also confirm no authz regressions — cross-check with authz unit tests and a small integration matrix.

lia-product: I'll draft a short comms note for customers who might see transient throttling, in case we need it. Keep messaging: protecting overall tenant SLOs and targeted fix is underway.

alex: thanks. action items: Jordan -> PR for gateway prefilter + canary rollout; Maria -> create synthetic load test and assertion checks; Lia -> customer comms draft; Alex -> start RFC follow-up doc for slice vectorization plan and link to this thread.

jordan-sre: starting PR now, will tag reviewers.

maria-plat: creating load job in the perf repo and will post results here.

alex: let's reconvene EOD once canary runs for a few hours. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
